title: Ruins of Grim Batol
wikitext:
The '''Ruins of Grim Batol''' refers to two areas of the same name, one in the [[Wetlands]] and the other in the [[Grim Reaches]]. In the Wetlands, the Ruins of Grim Batol are the entrance to the halls of the lost mountain city, leading to the entrance of [[Grim Batol (instance)|the raid]], occupied by the Red dragonflight. In the Grim Reaches, an ancient, destroyed passage in the western hills<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|36|To Cure the Withered}}</ref> leads to a forgotten outpost that is part of the outer ruins of Grim Batol and blocked off from the main city, where the shadow-cursed spirits of the Wildhammer defenders led by [[Thane Falod Swifthammer]] and the Dark Iron invaders still haunt the ruins.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|34|Shadow Curse}}</ref>
